scale_b.description: Iteration 9 frozen Scale-B smoke panel (20 families, 120 trajectories). DO NOT point Scale-C work at these paths.

scale_c.description: Iteration 10 Scale-C preliminary panel (100 families, 600 trajectories). Dedicated paths; never reuse Scale-B directories.

iteration_11_qwen35_2b.description: Iteration 11.6 confirmatory replay of the frozen 100-family Scale-C panel by Qwen3.5-2B (600 trajectories). Iteration 11 judges ONE TARGET PER PROFILE, and the four must stay separate sessions: prepare_blinded_items derives item_id from the index into a seed-42 shuffle of that target's own journal, so all four targets produce the same item_id range over the same 600 cells. Pooling them would collide every id four ways and merge distinct models' responses under one label. The panel is shared with scale_c by design -- that is the point of the cross-model arm -- but output_dir is per target so no two sessions write one artifact.

iteration_11_qwen35_4b.description: Iteration 11.6 confirmatory replay by Qwen3.5-4B (600 trajectories). One target per profile; see iteration_11_qwen35_2b for why the four sessions cannot be pooled.

iteration_11_ministral3_3b.description: Iteration 11.6 confirmatory replay by Ministral-3-3B (600 trajectories). One target per profile; see iteration_11_qwen35_2b for why the four sessions cannot be pooled.

iteration_11_phi4_mm.description: Iteration 11.6 confirmatory replay by Phi-4-multimodal (600 trajectories). One target per profile; see iteration_11_qwen35_2b for why the four sessions cannot be pooled. Judge only a run whose replay_report.json exists and whose iteration_11_replay_checks.json verdict is PASS: this target's first attempt was stopped at 197 cells by the LongRoPE defect documented under outputs/iteration_11/diagnostics/phi4_longrope/.
